exposure: Maximum diameter of gestational sac or mass under ultrasound
Treatment group (Curettage after medication, Curettage after uterine artery embolization,  Surgery)
Peritrophoblastic blood flow around the mass
Distance of gestational sac or mass from the uterine serosa layer
finding: While all three treatment methods for CSP showed high success rates and no significant difference in intraoperative bleeding, a longer menolipsis time and larger maximum diameter of the gestational sac or mass were identified as potential predictors for increased bleeding risk.
